name: Bicycle Crunch Burnout
description: Max slow bicycle crunches until failure

name: Russian Twist Burnout
description: Max reps each side until failure

name: Toe Touch Burnout
description: Lying flat, reach toes with straight legs, max reps

name: Scissor Kick Burnout
description: Alternating leg cross, continue until failure

name: Mountain Climber Core Burnout
description: Slow controlled mountain climbers, max reps

name: Seated Knee Tuck Burnout
description: Seated, tuck knees to chest, max reps until failure

name: Bear Hold Burnout
description: Knees 2 inches off floor, hold until failure

name: Cable Crossover Floor
description: Lie on floor with DBs, arc arms across chest and cross over — peak chest contraction

name: Svend Press
description: Hold two DBs pressed together at chest, squeeze and press forward keeping constant tension

name: Single Arm DB Fly
description: Lie on floor, one arm opens wide to floor while other stays stable — deeper chest stretch

name: Wide Push-Up
description: Wide grip push-up — shifts load to outer chest and biceps

name: Archer Push-Up
description: One arm extended sideways while other bends — loads each side independently

name: Typewriter Push-Up
description: Lower chest, slide side to side at bottom then press up — chest and bicep tension

name: Diamond Push-Up to Wide
description: Alternate diamond and wide grip each rep — tricep and chest combo

name: Zottman Curl
description: Curl up with palms facing up, rotate to palms facing down at top, lower slowly — works both bicep heads

name: Cross Body Curl
description: Curl one DB across body to opposite shoulder — targets brachialis for arm thickness

name: Wide Grip Curl
description: Hands wider than shoulder width on curl — emphasises short head of bicep

name: Close Grip Curl
description: Hands close together on curl — emphasises long head and peak of bicep

name: Waiter Curl
description: Hold one DB horizontally with both hands under the top plate, curl up — peak contraction

name: Slow Negative Curl
description: 3 seconds up, 5 seconds down — maximum time under tension for bicep growth

name: DB 21s
description: 7 reps bottom half, 7 reps top half, 7 full curls — classic bicep burnout finisher

name: DB Tate Press
description: Lie on floor, elbows flared wide, lower DBs to chest then press up — outer tricep head

name: DB Floor Press Close Grip
description: Floor press with hands close together — tricep dominant pressing movement

name: DB Rolling Tricep Extension
description: Skull crusher into a pullover — full stretch and contraction of tricep in one movement

name: Cobra Push-Up
description: Start lying flat, push chest up and back with arms straight — tricep and shoulder compound

name: Close Grip Push-Up
description: Hands close under chest, elbows track back — maximum tricep activation on push-up

name: Lying Tricep Extension
description: Lie on floor, lower DBs to temples with elbows pointing up, extend — classic tricep isolation

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: Hands in diamond shape under chest — heaviest tricep load of any push-up variation

name: Decline Diamond Push-Up
description: Feet elevated, hands in diamond — hardest tricep push-up variation

name: Slow Negative Curl Burnout
description: 3 seconds up, 5 seconds down — max reps until failure. Constant bicep tension.

name: Hammer Curl Burnout
description: Alternating hammer curls, neutral grip, no stopping until failure.

name: Concentration Curl Burnout
description: Seated, elbow on inner thigh, curl to failure — peak bicep isolation.

name: Wide Grip Curl Burnout
description: Hands wider than shoulder width, curl to failure — short head bias.

name: Waiter Curl Burnout
description: Hold one DB horizontally with both hands under plate, curl to failure.

name: DB Skull Crusher Burnout
description: Lie on floor, lower DBs to temples, extend to failure — tricep isolation burnout.

name: DB Overhead Extension Burnout
description: Both hands on one DB overhead, lower behind head and press to failure.
